defect: On hosted dev c3164945a (2026-11-25 13:38:50Z), POST /api/telemetry/replay?tag=poison_event over 19 poison_event dead letters (4 of 11/23, 15 of 11/24; 17 distinct ids, 2 self-conflicts) answered {"replayed": 15}, but public.telemetry_events received only the 3 rows from 11/23 while the 12 from 11/24 were suppressed by JetStream's 24h duplicate window because NatsJetStreamBuffer.put published with the same content-hash Nats-Msg-Id as the original publish, ignored PubAck.duplicate=true, returned True, and incremented _estimated_depth by 12.
fix: services/telemetry/buffer.py: _durable_receipt_id(event, replay_key=...) hashes the canonical payload digest together with replay_key when a replay key is provided; NatsJetStreamBuffer.put inspects PubAck.duplicate, increments total_duplicates without incrementing _estimated_depth or total_enqueued when duplicate=True, and returns a truthy typed PutResult(accepted=True, enqueued=False, duplicate=True, receipt_id=...).

services/telemetry/buffer.py: NatsJetStreamBuffer.sync_depth() and empty-poll resynchronisation in get() realign _estimated_depth with consumer_info (num_pending + num_ack_pending) whenever _estimated_depth differs from in-flight pending receipts.

services/telemetry/ingest_svc.py: TelemetryIngestService._ingest_event distinguishes broker-suppressed duplicates (put_result.duplicate=True) from newly enqueued events, incrementing total_duplicates instead of total_ingested while keeping ingest() return True so normal producer retries remain idempotent HTTP 200/202.

services/telemetry/ingest_svc.py: replay_dlq publishes each candidate DeadLetterEntry with replay_key=entry.rejected_at so JetStream does not suppress it because of the original publish, while replaying the same dead-letter entry twice inside the duplicate window is deduplicated by the broker and Postgres event_id conflict isolation decides the canonical outcome. Returns ReplayResult(int) equal to the count of genuinely enqueued entries and exposes .replayed, .suppressed, .refused, and .to_dict().
